The expert hosts

Why booking local matters

We don't just sell tours — we share our home, with 15 years of on-ground logistics behind every trip.

Deepest island knowledge

Hidden coves, seasonal secrets and the right beach for the right tide — things only residents know, built into your plan.

Verified local operators

Every boat, guide and dive crew is one we work with year-round — vetted for safety, not picked off a listing.

On-ground support that shows up

Ferry changes, weather calls, a missed connection — our own island team steps in, in person, on every major island.

Who we are

Andaman locals who plan the islands the way we'd travel them.

Since 2011 we've lived, dived and driven these islands — a Ministry of Tourism–recognised team running our own Havelock dive centre. One team handles your packages, ferries, transfers and stays, so nothing falls between the cracks. You pay 50% now and the rest only after you land.

CVE-2023-44487.summary: The HTTP/2 protocol allows a denial of service (server resource consumption) because request cancellation can reset many streams quickly, as exploited in the wild in August through October 2023.

CVE-2025-23419.summary:
When multiple server blocks are configured to share the same IP address and port, an attacker can use session resumption to bypass client certificate authentication requirements on these servers. This vulnerability arises when  TLS Session Tickets https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_ssl_module.html#ssl_session_ticket_key  are used and/or the  SSL session cache https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_ssl_module.html#ssl_session_cache  are used in the default server and the default server is performing client certificate authentication.  

Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.
